description: Retrieval-only expansion-rule benchmark. Expected sections were taken from the live Chroma index (750 chunks) and known-good Phase-1 regression probes — not invented from memory.

cases.query: How do I get an excuse slip if I missed class because I was sick?
expected_titles: How do I get an excuse slip if I missed class because I was sick
cases.notes: Live index returns Attendance Policy / FAQ excuse-slip article / Appendix J. Phase-1 regression kept the FAQ article in selected context.

cases.query: I was absent due to illness. Do I need a medical certificate for attendance?
acceptable_titles: How do I get an excuse slip if I missed class because I was sick
cases.notes: Attendance Policy (Article 8) is the handbook rule for illness absences; excuse-slip FAQ and Appendix J are related forms.

cases.query: How do I request a copy of grades?
expected_titles: Issuance of Copy of Documents Requested by Clients
acceptable_titles: Issuance of Transcript of Records/Transfer Credentials/Certifications/CAV/Authenticated Documents
cases.notes: Phase-1 regression selected Issuance of Copy of Documents first. Live probe also surfaces Copy of Grades (COG) under Retention and the TOR charter card.

cases.query: How do I request a transcript of records?
expected_titles: Issuance of Transcript of Records/Transfer Credentials/Certifications/CAV/Authenticated Documents
cases.notes: Citizen's Charter TOR issuance card is the indexed service section for TOR requests.

cases.query: How much are the fees for a transcript of records?
expected_titles: Issuance of Transcript of Records/Transfer Credentials/Certifications/CAV/Authenticated Documents
cases.notes: Fee amount lives on the TOR charter service card metadata/text in the live index.

cases.query: If I withdraw after paying enrollment fees, how much of my tuition is refunded?
cases.notes: Live index ranks Refunding of Fees (Article 3 > Registration > Sec. 3) first for this phrasing.

cases.query: What happens if I get an incomplete (INC) grade?
acceptable_titles: Failure to comply with certain requirements
cases.notes: Live index places INC grading sections under Article 7; Policies for INC is the dedicated section.

cases.query: What happens if I fail many of my subjects?
cases.notes: Live probe for fail-units phrasing ranks Scholastic Delinquency first.

cases.query: What is the retention policy?
acceptable_titles: Minimum Final Grade for any Non-board Program
cases.notes: Live index returns multiple Article 5 Retention Policies subsections for the generic retention query.

cases.query: What is the maximum residence rule?
cases.notes: Live index ranks Maximum Residence Rule (Article 11) first.

cases.query: Where do I file a petition for honorable dismissal?
cases.notes: Expected section is Article 12 Honorable Dismissal. Withdrawal Guidelines (Article 9) often ranks nearby and is NOT an acceptable substitute for this ask.

cases.query: How do I withdraw from the university?
cases.notes: Live index ranks Article 9 Withdrawal Policy/Guidelines for withdrawal phrasing.

cases.query: What do I need for OJT deployment?
cases.notes: Live index ranks Deployment of OJT first for OJT deployment phrasing.

cases.query: How do I get a good moral certificate?
cases.notes: Charter issuance cards are the service sections; Retention 'Good Moral' is a related but different Article 5 policy.

cases.query: TOR
expected_titles: Issuance of Transcript of Records/Transfer Credentials/Certifications/CAV/Authenticated Documents
cases.notes: Short form depends on expansion to recover the TOR charter card.

cases.query: Policies for INC
acceptable_titles: Failure to comply with certain requirements
cases.notes: Near-literal section title; semantic retrieval alone should suffice.

cases.query: Maximum Residence Rule
cases.notes: Exact section title query; expansion should be unnecessary.

cases.query: Deployment of OJT
cases.notes: Exact service title query.

cases.query: What is the weather in Manila today?
cases.notes: No campus document should be required; used to watch for accidental expansion hits into handbook sections.

cases.query: Who won the latest NBA finals?
cases.notes: Out-of-scope sports question.

cases.query: How do I bake chocolate chip cookies?
cases.notes: Out-of-scope cooking question.

cases.query: I was absent from work because of illness. What should I do?
cases.notes: Generic workplace phrasing that may falsely trigger campus attendance expansion. Expect no required campus section; used for false-positive analysis.

cases.query: Who is the president of the Philippines?
cases.notes: External president question; rule has blocked_terms, but still useful for false-positive checks against LSPU president sections.

cases.query: How do I enroll as a continuing student?
cases.notes: Enrollment charter/service card is the intended section; Assessment of Fees is a common near-miss.

cases.query: How much does it cost to drop a subject?
cases.notes: From existing rag_benchmark.py known-answer set; charter dropping fee should win.
